caption: The drawing depicts a dark teal or black chest of drawers with four horizontally aligned drawers, each featuring two round, golden-yellow knobs. The drawers and edges of the chest are bordered with a geometric pattern in red, yellow, and black. Each drawer front is decorated with a symmetrical, stylized floral motif in red, orange, and green, centered near the top of each drawer. The side panel of the chest displays a circular medallion with a star-like design, using red and yellow colors. The chest stands on four small, rounded feet, and the background is plain and light-colored, which frames the object with no additional items or scenery.
title: Chest of Drawers
